results.description:
Coming soon … return to Prythian with TWO new books in the Court of Thorns and Roses series. Pre-order A Court of Splintered Harmony for 27th October 26, and A Court of Forgotten Melody for 12th January 27.


A Court of Frost and Starlight is an unmissable companion tale to the GLOBAL PHENOMENON and TikTok sensation, from multi-million and #1 bestselling author Sarah J. Maas

Maas has established herself as a fantasy fiction titan – Time
Think Game of Thrones meets Buffy the Vampire Slayer with a drizzle of E.L. James – Telegraph
Spiced with slick plotting and atmospheric world-building ... a page-turning delight – Guardian
Sarah J. Maas does not disappoint … To be devoured with relish – Mail

******

In this companion tale to the bestselling Court of Thorns and Roses series, Feyre, Rhys and their friends are working to rebuild the Night Court and the vastly changed world beyond after the events of A Court of Wings and Ruin.

But Winter Solstice is finally near, and with it a hard-earned reprieve. Yet even the festive atmosphere can't keep the shadows of the past from looming. As Feyre navigates her first Winter Solstice as High Lady, she finds that those dearest to her have more wounds than she anticipated – scars that will have a far-reaching impact on the future of their court.

Sarah J. Maas's books have sold more than seventy-five million copies and are published in forty languages. Discover the sweeping romantic fantasy that everyone's talking about for yourself.

The Court of Thorns and Roses series includes:
A Court of Thorns and Roses
A Court of Mist and Fury
A Court of Wings and Ruin
A Court of Frost and Starlight
A Court of Silver Flames
A Court of Splintered Harmony
A Court of Forgotten Melody
